rules.title: Keep prayer orientation distinct from room location
rules.principle: Jain recommends worshipper facing E, idol facing W.
rules.measurement: Model idol front, worshipper location and actual access in the room.
rules.repair: Rotate arrangement without relocating room unnecessarily.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Orient WC user north or south in selected profile
rules.principle: Jain discourages E/W-facing WC use.
rules.measurement: Use seated-person direction, not cistern/front-wall label; preserve usable bathroom fit.
rules.repair: Rotate fixture and recheck soil connection/clearances.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Prefer south/west heavy storage
rules.principle: Locate substantial wardrobes/storage toward S/W/SW in the relevant room.
rules.measurement: Test actual closet footprint, usable access, door swing and room-scale orientation.
rules.repair: Reposition built-in storage without sacrificing structure/egress.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Keep legal daylight openings toward north/east when possible
rules.principle: N/E openings are favored by these books.
rules.measurement: Compare usable/exposed openings by orientation; statutory light/ventilation and boundary permission remain gates.
rules.repair: Shift rooms or court arrangement; do not draw illegal boundary windows.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Prefer a legible larger main entrance
rules.principle: Main entry is emphasized as larger than other domestic doors.
rules.measurement: Compare actual clear openings; do not reduce other required opening widths.
rules.repair: Increase entry where feasible and desired.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Door swing preferences cannot override exit/access requirements
rules.principle: Books favor inward/clockwise entry; thresholds are also mentioned.
rules.measurement: Separate preference from required egress swing/accessibility and landing clearance; coordinate sign convention.
rules.repair: Use safe compliant swing; record departure rather than adding a hazardous threshold.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Odd stair count is an optional secondary detail
rules.principle: Books prefer odd steps but do not establish an engineering riser-count convention.
rules.measurement: Before enabling, define whether count is risers per flight or total rise; keep risers uniform and within legal limits.
rules.repair: Choose a different valid count only if safe; never add a tiny step.
rules.conflict: Counting convention unspecified. Default is manual advisory, not executable.

rules.title: Prefer orthogonal landing stairs
rules.principle: Jain favors square/rectangular right-angle arrangements over circular/spiral. Owner separately selects half-turn with landing as Nepal default.
rules.measurement: Check actual stair type; straight/quarter-turn alternatives can be compliant and user-selected.
rules.repair: Start with U-stair and landing; preserve legal geometry and structure.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Parking location is not a vehicle-access calculation
rules.principle: Jain favors SE/NW garage and discourages NE.
rules.measurement: Only score after maneuvering, gates, walking paths and area accounting pass.
rules.repair: Choose feasible parking first, then best directional fit.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Landscape and drainage preferences need site engineering
rules.principle: Sources favor lower/open N/E/NE; this is a preference, not authorization to direct water there.
rules.measurement: Check actual lawful outfall, falls, neighboring plots and accessibility.
rules.repair: Keep engineered drainage; acknowledge directional mismatch rather than flood another site.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Keep worship space dedicated and calm
rules.principle: Prefer a distinct, uncluttered prayer zone separate from bedroom/kitchen functions.
rules.measurement: Check use and furniture conflicts; dedicated alcove only by explicit household choice.
rules.repair: Reserve appropriate floor area early.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Use color as a reversible preference
rules.principle: Room-specific light/warm palettes are discussed; retain owner choice and local multicolor facade preference.
rules.measurement: Apply colors to actual surfaces after geometry; do not claim health or wealth effects.
rules.repair: Offer palette variants without disguising structural/window changes.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Do not use symbolic remedies as geometric repairs
rules.principle: Jain describes symbolic mirror/remedy practices. These do not change stairs, structure or plan geometry.
rules.measurement: Keep any user-requested ritual item separate from geometry compliance.
rules.repair: Report original geometric preference failure; never erase it with a remedy.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Design from household activity and usable furniture
rules.principle: Svoboda emphasizes intention and practical use; apply the earlier Keystone activity-first design approach.
rules.measurement: Prove bed/work/seating/fixture clearances and useful paths.
rules.repair: Rework room geometry before decoration.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Preserve a readable entrance-to-private-space sequence
rules.principle: Entry experience and what is visible affect spatial organization.
rules.measurement: Guest routes to public spaces should not require crossing private bedrooms.
rules.repair: Recluster public/private rooms; minimize wasted corridors.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Interpret the tradition as a whole, not disconnected compass slogans
rules.principle: Chakrabarti distinguishes integrated traditional systems from selective contemporary prescriptions.
rules.measurement: Record selected tradition, mandala interpretation, household intent and source conflicts.
rules.repair: Avoid mixing conflicting rules while calling them universal.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Use practice profiles for spatial inspiration only
rules.principle: The uploaded magazine PDF profiles architecture practices; its title is not proof of a Vaastu rule system.
rules.measurement: Extract case-specific spatial lessons only after inspecting relevant project pages.
rules.repair: Do not invent directional doctrine from an architectural firm name.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.

rules.title: Treat the illustrated plans as references, not Nepal-approved templates
rules.principle: Pathi supplies plan images and a general principles section, not Nepal permit or RC certification.
rules.measurement: Check each selected image scale, openings, stairs, structure and local applicability.
rules.repair: Rebuild and validate an adapted plan instead of tracing it as approved.
rules.conflict: No consensus claim; apply the selected household profile and mandatory safety constraints.
